findings: TRM's October 29 incident report attributes 233.46M native XRP transferred from five Binance-attributed XRPL wallets to one attacker address; TRM says it remained there at its 00:30 UTC cutoff. The report's North Korea/TraderTraitor attribution is TRM's high-confidence assessment; Binance root cause was not yet published.

Coinbase Q3 2026 Form 10-Q reveals one unnamed counterparty contributed 27% of Q3 revenue and 25% of nine-month revenue. Its identity and risk channel remain unknown; no link to Circle or Ripple is inferred.

Coinbase Q3 recognized lending collateral was USD1.009297B and recognized derivatives collateral USD301.943M; the token-level tables name BTC and ETH but no XRP. A separate USD3.284562B unrecognized customer-collateral pool has no token-level breakdown, so zero XRP exposure cannot be inferred.
Circle Mint Q2 2026 net fiat conversions were -USD3.780B and H1 -USD1.997B. These are Circle Mint customer conversions, not total USDC market-wide flows or XRP capital flows.

Circle's Q2 reserve structure was approximately 84% BlackRock-managed Circle Reserve Fund and 16% bank cash. Aggregate FDIC coverage was approximately USD1.8M across seven reserve banks; stablecoin-holder liabilities are not FDIC insured.

Circle's own 19.5% weighted-average USDC-on-platform share is a Circle metric, not Coinbase's. Coinbase's Q3 average USDC held in eligible products was USD22B; Circle's Coinbase-related distribution costs were USD324.6M Q2 and USD655.3M H1.

T54's dashboard reports 14.736M x402 service payments and USD42,048.63 settled, implying approximately USD0.00285 per payment if scopes match. It supports XRP, RLUSD and USDC; asset mix is undisclosed and some entries are Unverified. No native-XRP demand is inferred.

Mastercard AP4M lists Coinbase, Ripple and t54 Labs as participants in a multi-rail partner ecosystem; it does not specify XRP/XRPL settlement. t54's Evernorth integration remains intended, and Evernorth's reported 473M XRP treasury is a holding, not a market flow.

Fresh-main PR #1371 was created from main 653b66de9a9545bc756a34385972f06038229783 to remove scheduled cross-analysis writes. Exact-head CI passed 347 tests plus 8 subtests; fail-closed gate passed and explicitly kept merging disabled. PR remains draft/open/unmerged/mergeable.

Main still has a write-enabled cross-analysis workflow and a mutation-capable manual merge queue. PR #1368 and #1369 are behind current main; PR #1370 is based on current main and has passed its exact-head core CI and fail-closed gate.
